# Suliko

> Suliko is an AI-powered document translation service for legal, technical and business documents in 50+ languages, with a Georgian-language focus. Operated by Suliko Solutions LLC (Georgia). English site: suliko.ai (formerly suliko.io), Georgian site: suliko.ge.

## Main pages
- [Suliko (English)](https://suliko.ai/en): product overview, pricing in EUR
- [Suliko (Georgian)](https://suliko.ge/ka): product overview, pricing in GEL
- [Blog](https://suliko.ai/en/blog): guides on document and legal translation
- [About](https://suliko.ai/en/about): company details

## Contact
- Email: info@suliko.ai (suliko.ge: info@suliko.ge)

## Notes
- suliko.io is the former address of suliko.ai and redirects to it.
